newsitem.title: USA: Schroder raises Valero 1997 EPS forecast. [CORRECTED 19:27 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Schroder raises Valero 1997 EPS forecast. [CORRECTED 19:27 GMT]

text.p: Schroder & Co has raised its forecast for Valero Energy Corp's 1997 earnings per share to $1.90 from $1.85 after the company reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.55, some five cents better than expected, for the second quarter.

The slightly better than expected earnings (corrects from "positive earnings surprise") came from refining operations, which earned $64 million more than forecast (corrects from "...earned $64 million, or five cents a share more than forecast..."), analysts Michael Mayer and Philip Tendler said in a report.
Schroder is maintaining the stock as a market outperform and has a target price of $42 for Valero, which was off 1/4 at 39-1/4 in afternoon trade. ((David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
